**Pilp**. **my heart palpitates**

5516:

**1.** general of Jabin, king of Hazor
**2.** returned exiles
5523:
סֻכּוֹת 18 _n.pr.loc_.
**1.** (expl. from Jacob making **booths**)
**2.** first station of Isr. at Exodus

**Piel** **make foolish**, **turn into foolishness**
**Niph**. **act** or **do foolishly**
**Hiph**. **do foolishly**, **play the fool**
5532:
[סָכַן] _vb_. **be of use** or **service**, **benefit**

**1.** **be of use** or **service**

**Hiph**. **be used**, **wont**, strictly **exhibit use**, or **habit**
5534:

**Niph**. **the mouth** of liars **shall be stopped**

[סָלָה] _vb_. **make light of**, **toss aside**

5549:
[סָלַל] _vb_. **lift up**, **cast up**

**1.** **cast up a highway**

**Hithp**. **exalt oneself**
5562: סַמְגַּר נְבוֹ _n.pr.m_. an officer of Nebuchad. acc. to MT [[24-jeremiah.39.3|Je 39:3]]

**1.**
**a.** **lean** or **lay** hand upon

**2.** **support**, **uphold**, **sustain**
**Niph**. reflex. **support**, or **brace oneself**
**Pi**. **sustain** (refresh, revive) **me with raisin-cakes**.

סָמַר _vb_. **bristle up**

**Pi**. [[18-job.4.15|Jb 4:15]].

5572: סְנֶה _n.m_. a thorny bush, perh. **blackberry bush**

5588: [סֵעֵף] _adj_. **divided**, **half-hearted**;—pl. abs. as subst., in religious sense, [[19-psalms.119.113|ψ 119:113]]

[סָעַר] _vb_. **storm**, **rage**
**Qal** **they** [my foes] **storm along** to scatter me

**Po**. shall be **like chaff** (which) **is storm-driven** from a threshing-floor.
5595:
[סָפָה] _vb_. **sweep** or **snatch away**, **catch up**
**Qal**
**1.** intrans. **be snatched away**
**2.** trans. **sweep away**
**Niph**.
**1.** **be swept away**, **destroyed**
**2.** **be caught up**, **captured**

[סָפַח] _vb_. **join**, **attach to**

**Hithp**. they have driven me out **from joining myself** with the inheritance of י׳.
